chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:

A slave girl of ours was afflicted with menstruation, and it did not cease from her until she was near death. So Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) ordered that she be given Suweeq of lentils to drink. She was given it, so it ceased from her, and she recovered.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far (referring to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir, peace be upon him)
key_terms.سَوِيقَ الْعَدَسِ: Suweeq of lentils (a thick porridge made from lentils)

ai.seo_question: What is the remedy for prolonged menstruation according to Imam Abu Ja'far (AS)?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practical medical wisdom of Imam Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him), demonstrating the integration of dietary therapy with spiritual authority in Shia tradition. The specific use of lentil *suweeq* (a thick porridge) underscores the Prophetic tradition of utilizing accessible, nutrient-dense foods for healing, a practice often cited in *Tib al-Nabi* (Medicine of the Prophet). It serves as a foundational text for understanding how Imams applied empirical knowledge to resolve specific physiological ailments, reinforcing the holistic view of health in Shia jurisprudence.
